prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit autumn park with orange trees, a stone bridge with a waist-high parapet and a standard bench on a leaf-strewn path, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Ethiopian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smooth warm-brown skin, a bold thick black liner drawn around the whole eye and winged slightly at the outer corner, warm gold and brown eyeshadow, strongly defined softly arched brows, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural warm rose-brown lip with a soft gloss, a serene, dignified expression, soft pastel-lavender hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large brass hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a lead square-sided cowbell, a tin chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold hammer head, a bronze cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop with a heavy rough copper a round bell hanging at its end, and two to three rose-gold necklaces. Extremely long oval nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay), wide gold-and-silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric star inlay filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme black platform stiletto heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Korean person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a striking young male model face with sharp straight brows, a strong chin and a visible Adam's apple, clean-shaven, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, luminous porcelain skin, a calm easy look, sleek silver-grey hair styled in curly, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked silver bracelets. Extremely long round nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and powerful athletic woman, far beyond any real person; wide capped boulder-like shoulders, a broad flaring back and lats forming a dramatic V-taper, defined muscular arms, a firm chest, a deeply defined six-pack abdomen on a very narrow waist, round firm hips and strong muscular thighs with a visible quad sweep and defined calves; hard clean muscle under glowing skin, not bulky like a bodybuilder, not thin; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework), wide bold silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense lattice fills filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white platform stiletto slingbacks, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
